# Complete example

Combines an AzAPI resource group and identity with multiple parent-owned reservations, non-default zones/SKUs, resource-group RBAC/lock, individual reservation RBAC/lock, retries and timeouts.

`primary` fans out to one reservation per `reservation_zones` entry (two by default). Each gets one unit **per zone**, inherits `{ environment = "example" }`, and has its own reservation-scoped lock and Reader assignment. `replacement` uses another SKU in the first zone and replaces inherited tags with `{ workload = "explicit-replacement" }`. `untagged` uses a third SKU in that zone and explicitly clears tags with `{}`. No maps are merged. `vm_sizes` and `reservation_zones` let the operator select approved capacity rather than relying on fixed availability.

The defaults reserve **four VM slots** (D2s\_v5 in two zones, D4s\_v5 and D8s\_v5 in one zone each); unused reserved capacity is billed. Choose one zone to reduce the demonstration to three slots. Distinct effective size/zone tuples are mandatory even when reservation names differ. Expanded output keys include `7:primary:zone-1`, `11:replacement:zone-1` and `8:untagged:zone-1`, plus the other primary zones.

**Deployment creates billable reserved compute capacity.** Obtain explicit subscription, isolated scope, quota, SKU/zone, cost and cleanup approval before deploying. It requires role-assignment and lock permissions; registrations are not performed by this example. This example has not been deployed as part of local refactoring.

The root lock protects the entire resource group, including the example identity. The child lock and child Reader assignment target only the reservation ARM ID. Parent-owned children (including their extensions) and root RBAC are ordered before the RG lock; the child lock follows child RBAC. Other independently managed resources need their own ordering. Selective replacement requires staged removal of all applicable locks, propagation wait and relock. Retry settings can help with propagation but do not prove teardown.

`resource_id` exposes the group ARM ID for opt-in consumption by an existing VM owner; `capacity_reservation_resource_ids` exposes a keyed map of child ARM IDs. No VM is created or modified here. See the root's association contract for the exact VM-side ARM property and the distinction from platform `reservationId`.

```hcl
data "azapi_client_config" "this" {}

resource "azapi_resource" "resource_group" {
  location               = var.location
  name                   = var.resource_group_name
  parent_id              = data.azapi_client_config.this.subscription_resource_id
  type                   = "Microsoft.Resources/resourceGroups@2024-03-01"
  response_export_values = []
}

resource "azapi_resource" "identity" {
  location               = var.location
  name                   = "capacity-reader"
  parent_id              = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  type                   = "Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities@2023-01-31"
  response_export_values = ["properties.principalId"]
}

module "capacity_reservation_group" {
  source = "../../"

  capacity_reservation_group_name = "capacity-complete"
  location                        = var.location
  parent_id                       = azapi_resource.resource_group.id
  capacity_reservations = {
    primary = {
      name  = "primary"
      sku   = { name = var.vm_sizes.primary, capacity = 1, tier = "Standard" }
      zones = var.reservation_zones
      lock  = { kind = "CanNotDelete", notes = "Example individual reservation lock" }
      role_assignments = {
        reader = {
          role_definition_id_or_name       = "/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/acdd72a7-3385-48ef-bd42-f606fba81ae7"
          principal_id                     = azapi_resource.identity.output.properties.principalId
          principal_type                   = "ServicePrincipal"
          skip_service_principal_aad_check = true
        }
      }
    }
    replacement = {
      name  = "replacement"
      sku   = { name = var.vm_sizes.replacement, capacity = 1 }
      zones = [var.reservation_zones[0]]
      tags  = { workload = "explicit-replacement" }
    }
    untagged = {
      name  = "untagged"
      sku   = { name = var.vm_sizes.untagged, capacity = 1 }
      zones = [var.reservation_zones[0]]
      tags  = {}
    }
  }
  enable_telemetry = var.enable_telemetry
  lock = {
    kind  = "CanNotDelete"
    notes = "Example resource-group lock"
  }
  retry = {
    error_message_regex  = ["ScopeLocked", "PrincipalNotFound"]
    interval_seconds     = 15
    max_interval_seconds = 60
  }
  role_assignments = {
    reader = {
      role_definition_id_or_name       = "Reader"
      principal_id                     = azapi_resource.identity.output.properties.principalId
      principal_type                   = "ServicePrincipal"
      skip_service_principal_aad_check = true
    }
  }
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
  tags            = { environment = "example" }
  timeouts        = { create = "30m", delete = "30m" }
  zones           = var.reservation_zones
}
```

## Required Inputs

No required inputs.

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: Whether to enable AVM telemetry for this example.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: Region with approved capacity reservation quota and the selected SKU/zone available.

Type: `string`

Default: `"eastus"`

### <a name="input_reservation_zones"></a> [reservation\_zones](#input\_reservation\_zones)

Description: Approved distinct zones for primary fan-out and the group envelope. Secondary definitions use the first zone. Quantity is one PER ZONE.

Type: `list(string)`

Default:

```json
[
  "1",
  "2"
]
```

### <a name="input_resource_group_name"></a> [resource\_group\_name](#input\_resource\_group\_name)

Description: Unique name for an isolated example resource group.

Type: `string`

Default: `"capacity-reservation-complete-example"`

### <a name="input_subscription_id"></a> [subscription\_id](#input\_subscription\_id)

Description: AzAPI subscription; null uses normal provider authentication configuration.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_vm_sizes"></a> [vm\_sizes](#input\_vm\_sizes)

Description: Three distinct capacity-reservation-supported VM sizes with approved quota in the chosen region/zones. Defaults reserve four VM slots across two zones; unused capacity is billed.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    primary     = string
    replacement = string
    untagged    = string
  })
```

Default:

```json
{
  "primary": "Standard_D2s_v5",
  "replacement": "Standard_D4s_v5",
  "untagged": "Standard_D8s_v5"
}
```

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_capacity_reservation_resource_ids"></a> [capacity\_reservation\_resource\_ids](#output\_capacity\_reservation\_resource\_ids)

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: Capacity reservation group ARM ID.
